standpoint.title: Standpoint Deployment · Console
standpoint.subtitle: While you're offline, the background monitoring agent (OpenClaw Monitoring Engine) automatically deploys, classifies, and generates replies according to your standpoint.
standpoint.safetyItem1Lead: Account “binding” only records a platform + handle representation,
standpoint.safetyItem1Strong: no real credentials are stored and no real login happens
standpoint.safetyItem2Strong: Nothing is actually posted to third-party platforms
standpoint.safetyItem2Tail: (real automated posting violates most platforms' terms of service).
standpoint.safetyItem3: “Send” only marks the message as replied within this system (simulation / record).
standpoint.safetyItem4Strong: You must click send yourself on the platform for every reply
standpoint.safetyItem4Tail: ; this platform never auto-posts for you.
standpoint.safetyItem5Tail: ; make sure you understand what it means before turning it on.

standpoint.autoSendDescLead: Once enabled, for messages that match the rules a running agent will

standpoint.replyMaliciousDesc: Generate a rebuttal to messages judged malicious, according to your standpoint.
standpoint.replyQuestionsDesc: Generate useful replies to questions or requests based on your knowledge base.
standpoint.accountsHint: Demo only: records platform + handle; no real credentials stored / no actual posting.

hotPage.rulesWhatBody: Trending ranks content by real user engagement, surfacing what the whole site cares about right now.
hotPage.rulesPoint1: [Hot] A heat score combines likes, comments, and views — higher scores rank higher.
hotPage.rulesPoint2: [Fresh] Newer content gets a recency boost; heat decays naturally over time.
hotPage.rulesPoint3: [Genuine] Engage because you like it — gaming the numbers earns no extra boost.
hotPage.rulesPoint4: [All types] Business ideas, feedback, shares, daily posts, and updates all compete.
